records.title: Do people intervene to make others behave prosocially?

records.title: What Motivates Paternalism? An Experimental Study

records.limit: Reported welfare rationale does not prove actual recipient autonomy consent

records.title: Free to Fail? Paternalistic Preferences in the United States

records.limit: 2023 working paper, Aug 2026 conditionally accepted, not final published journal; no A extraction advantage
records.version_note: 2023 working paper, 2026 revised version, 2026 journal forthcoming and 2026 authors' replication dataset are one empirical research work.

records.title: An experimental test of whether financial incentives constitute undue inducement in decision-making
records.result: Two human experiments n671,n406: greater financial incentive shifts information seeking, not confirmed tested welfare loss
records.limit: Bias of information choice alone insufficient proof of exploitative harm; welfare metric scenario-specific

records.title: The moral preferences of investors: Experimental evidence
records.result: Moral stock premium not contingent on own causal impact, value alignment rather than impact seeking
records.limit: Own moral identity premium cannot proxy protecting distinct counterparty

records.title: Trading off autonomy and efficiency in choice architectures: Self-nudging versus social nudging
records.result: n1080; self-nudge median 50%, exogenous full-cooperation default increases private-default aggregate output; gap nonsignificant with public defaults
records.limit: Aggregate payoff versus individual autonomy are not interchangeable endpoints

records.title: Interventionist Preferences and the Welfare State: The Case of In-Kind Aid

records.limit: NBER WORKING PAPER, not confirmed peer reviewed; restriction motives include differing positive/negative autonomy valuation

records.title: Parental paternalism and patience
